phase_name: Final ABORT Conditions Before Measurement Workflow Execution Design
phase_japanese_name: 測定ワークフロー実行直前の最終ABORT条件設計
purpose: Design final ABORT (emergency stop) conditions that must be continuously monitored and evaluated immediately before Phase 15-7 and 15-8 measurement workflow execution begins, serving as the last-line-of-defense safety gate

scope_1_final_abort_condition_categories.description: Design 6 categories of final ABORT conditions that, if detected immediately before execution, must trigger immediate execution termination

category_1_state_consistency_violation.description: ABORT if any final state consistency check fails at execution time (after Phase 18-2/18-3 passed but before Phase 15-7/15-8 starts)

abort_triggers.trigger: integrated_decision changed from NO_GO to GO by unauthorized actor
abort_triggers.check: integrated_decision must remain NO_GO until Phase 15-7 measurement changes it
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Alert authority. Investigate unauthorized state change.

abort_triggers.trigger: receiver_validator_permission changed from NOT_EFFECTIVE to EFFECTIVE by unauthorized actor
abort_triggers.check: receiver_validator_permission must remain NOT_EFFECTIVE until Phase 15-8 measurement changes it
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Alert authority. Investigate unauthorized state change.

abort_triggers.trigger: app_implementation_status changed from NO_GO to GO before Phase 15-7/15-8 completion
abort_triggers.check: app_implementation_status must remain NO_GO until measurement workflows complete
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Critical safety violation. Emergency security review.

abort_triggers.trigger: tests_implementation_status changed from NO_GO to GO before Phase 15-7/15-8 completion
abort_triggers.check: tests_implementation_status must remain NO_GO until measurement workflows complete
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Critical safety violation. Emergency security review.

abort_triggers.trigger: production_status changed from NO_GO (should never change)
abort_triggers.check: production_status must ALWAYS remain NO_GO during design phases
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. CRITICAL security incident. Immediate escalation.

category_2_evidence_integrity_violation.description: ABORT if any evidence lock or audit trail has been tampered with since Phase 18-4 locking

abort_triggers.trigger: Phase 18-4 evidence lock hash verification fails (hash mismatch detected)
abort_triggers.check: Recompute SHA-256+ hash of Phase 18-2/18-3 check results and compare against Phase 18-4 stored hash
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Evidence tampering detected. Security incident response activated.

abort_triggers.trigger: Phase 18-4 authority signature verification fails (signature invalid, revoked, or expired)
abort_triggers.check: Verify authority signature validity, revocation status, and expiry time
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Authority signature invalid. Require fresh signature and full re-check.

abort_triggers.trigger: Audit trail missing or corrupted since Phase 18-4 locking
abort_triggers.check: Verify audit trail append-only integrity. Confirm Phase 18-4 lock record exists and is unmodified.
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Evidence loss detected. Critical security incident.

abort_triggers.trigger: Phase 18-2/18-3 check results JSON modified since Phase 18-4 locking
abort_triggers.check: Compare Phase 18-4 stored check results hash against current file hash
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Check results tampered. Restart from Phase 18-2/18-3 with fresh verification.

category_3_authority_and_permission_viol.description: ABORT if authority signature or approver permissions have become invalid or insufficient

abort_triggers.trigger: Approving authority has been revoked or disabled since Phase 18-2/18-3 execution
abort_triggers.check: Verify authority is still ACTIVE and not marked REVOKED or DISABLED in authorization system
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Authority revoked. Obtain fresh signature from new authority.

abort_triggers.trigger: Authority signature has expired (current_utc > signature_valid_to_utc)
abort_triggers.check: Compare signature expiry timestamp against system UTC clock
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Signature expired. Obtain fresh signature from authority.

abort_triggers.trigger: Authority role or permission scope has been reduced since Phase 18-2/18-3 execution
abort_triggers.check: Verify authority has permissions to approve Phase 15-7 and/or Phase 15-8 execution (role must not change)
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Authority permissions insufficient. Escalate to higher authority.

abort_triggers.trigger: Multi-authority requirement not met (if Phase 18-2/18-3 requires dual signatures)
abort_triggers.check: Verify all required authority signatures are present, valid, and not expired
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Missing required authority signature. Obtain second signature.

category_4_security_threat_or_incident.description: ABORT if any active security threat or incident condition detected immediately before execution

abort_triggers.trigger: Security threat alert triggered (ransomware detection, intrusion detection, malware signature match)
abort_triggers.check: Query security monitoring system for active threat alerts in execution environment
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Active security threat. Incident response activated.

abort_triggers.trigger: Network connectivity anomaly or suspicious activity detected
abort_triggers.check: Monitor for unusual network patterns (port scanning, unusual traffic, connection attempts to unauthorized systems)
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Network security anomaly. Incident investigation required.

abort_triggers.trigger: Infrastructure compromise detected or suspected
abort_triggers.check: Verify infrastructure integrity: file system consistency, system file checksums, process integrity
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Infrastructure compromise suspected. Forensic investigation required.

abort_triggers.trigger: Privilege escalation or unauthorized access attempt detected
abort_triggers.check: Monitor system logs for privilege escalation, unauthorized sudo/admin access, role elevation attempts
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Unauthorized access attempt. Security lockdown activated.

category_5_blocking_condition_reactivati.description: ABORT if a blocking condition that was previously cleared has become active again since Phase 18-2/18-3 checks

abort_triggers.trigger: Phase 43 (ai_media_os initial stable operation) enters unstable state or reverts to NO_GO
abort_triggers.check: Verify Phase 43 still reports stable operation status before Phase 15-7/15-8 execution
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Blocking condition reactivated. Restart Phase 43 stability verification.

abort_triggers.trigger: Phase 47-B dry-run reverts to NO-GO or incomplete status
abort_triggers.check: Verify Phase 47-B dry-run completion status has not regressed
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Prerequisite workflow regressed. Re-execute Phase 47-B dry-run.

abort_triggers.trigger: receiver_validator_implementation_change detected (Phase 18-3 only)
abort_triggers.check: Verify receiver_validator code and configuration have not changed since Phase 18-3 check_5 execution
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Implementation change detected. Update design, re-lock evidence, restart checks.

abort_triggers.trigger: Dependent system or external service becomes unavailable
abort_triggers.check: Monitor availability of all dependencies required for Phase 15-7/15-8 execution
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Dependency unavailable. Restore dependency and retry.

category_6_timing_and_authorization_wind.description: ABORT if execution falls outside authorized time window or required delay conditions

abort_triggers.trigger: Current UTC timestamp outside authorized execution window
abort_triggers.check: Verify current_utc is within authorized_execution_window_start and authorized_execution_window_end
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Outside authorized window. Defer to next authorized execution window.

abort_triggers.trigger: Insufficient delay since last Phase 15-7/15-8 execution (if repeated measurement prohibited)
abort_triggers.check: Verify minimum_delay_since_last_execution has elapsed since previous Phase 15-7/15-8 completion
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Minimum delay not met. Defer execution.

abort_triggers.trigger: Phase 18-2/18-3 check results stale (too much time elapsed since checks completed)
abort_triggers.check: Verify execution_time_utc - phase18_check_completion_time_utc < maximum_staleness_threshold (e.g., 24 hours)
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Check results stale. Re-execute Phase 18-2/18-3 fresh checks.

abort_triggers.trigger: Authority signature approaching expiry (expiring within next execution window)
abort_triggers.check: Verify signature_valid_to_utc - current_utc > minimum_remaining_validity (e.g., 1 hour)
abort_triggers.action: ABORT. Signature expiring soon. Obtain fresh signature before execution.

scope_2_final_abort_verification_procedu.description: Design the final verification procedure to be executed immediately before Phase 15-7/15-8 measurement workflow launch

pre_launch_verification_step_1_state_con.timing: Immediately before Phase 15-7/15-8 launch (< 10 seconds before execution begins)
checks: Verify integrated_decision == NO_GO (must not change until Phase 15-7 measurement)
Verify receiver_validator_permission == NOT_EFFECTIVE (must not change until Phase 15-8 measurement)
Verify app_implementation_status == NO_GO
Verify tests_implementation_status == NO_GO
Verify production_status == NO_GO
pre_launch_verification_step_1_state_con.failure_action: ABORT immediately. Do not launch Phase 15-7/15-8. Alert authority.

pre_launch_verification_step_2_evidence_.timing: Immediately before Phase 15-7/15-8 launch (< 10 seconds before execution begins)
checks: Verify Phase 18-4 evidence lock hash (re-hash Phase 18-2/18-3 results, compare against stored hash)
Verify Phase 18-4 authority signature validity and non-expiry
Verify audit trail integrity (Phase 18-4 lock record present and unmodified)
Verify Phase 18-2/18-3 check results JSON has not been modified since Phase 18-4 locking
pre_launch_verification_step_2_evidence_.failure_action: ABORT immediately. Evidence tampering or corruption detected. Activate security incident response.

pre_launch_verification_step_3_authority.timing: Immediately before Phase 15-7/15-8 launch (< 10 seconds before execution begins)
checks: Verify approving authority is ACTIVE (not revoked, disabled, or deactivated)
Verify authority signature has not expired (current_utc < signature_valid_to_utc)
Verify authority has permission to approve Phase 15-7 and/or Phase 15-8 execution
Verify all required multi-authority signatures present (if applicable)
pre_launch_verification_step_3_authority.failure_action: ABORT immediately. Authority invalid or insufficient. Obtain fresh signature or escalate authority.

pre_launch_verification_step_4_security_.timing: Immediately before Phase 15-7/15-8 launch (< 10 seconds before execution begins)
checks: Query security monitoring system: Any active threat alerts? (Response must be: NO)
Query infrastructure integrity system: Any integrity violations detected? (Response must be: NO)
Query network monitoring: Any suspicious activity or anomalies? (Response must be: NO)
Query access logs: Any unauthorized access attempts or privilege escalation? (Response must be: NO)
pre_launch_verification_step_4_security_.failure_action: ABORT immediately. Security threat detected. Incident response activated.

pre_launch_verification_step_5_blocking_.timing: Immediately before Phase 15-7/15-8 launch (< 10 seconds before execution begins)
checks: Verify Phase 43 status is still STABLE (not regressed to NO-GO)
Verify Phase 47-B dry-run completion status is still COMPLETE (not regressed)
Verify receiver_validator implementation has not changed (Phase 18-3 only)
Verify all dependency services are still AVAILABLE
pre_launch_verification_step_5_blocking_.failure_action: ABORT immediately. Blocking condition reactivated. Restart prerequisite verification.

pre_launch_verification_step_6_timing_an.timing: Immediately before Phase 15-7/15-8 launch (< 10 seconds before execution begins)
checks: Verify current_utc is within authorized_execution_window (start ≤ current_utc ≤ end)
Verify minimum delay since last execution has elapsed (if repeated execution restricted)
Verify Phase 18-2/18-3 check results are not stale (within maximum_staleness_threshold)
Verify authority signature has sufficient remaining validity (> minimum_remaining_validity)
pre_launch_verification_step_6_timing_an.failure_action: ABORT immediately. Timing constraint violated. Defer to next authorized window or refresh signatures.

all_6_steps_pass.action: Proceed to Phase 15-7/15-8 measurement workflow execution launch. Record execution start timestamp in audit trail.

any_step_fails.action: ABORT execution immediately. Do not launch Phase 15-7/15-8. Document ABORT reason. Alert authority. Return to appropriate remediation procedure from Phase 18-5.

scope_3_abort_execution_and_recovery.description: Procedures for executing ABORT if any final verification fails, and recovery workflow

step_1_abort_initiation.action: If any of the 6 verification steps fail, immediately initiate ABORT
actions_to_perform: STOP Phase 15-7/15-8 execution (if already started, terminate immediately)
Record ABORT timestamp in audit trail
Document ABORT reason and failing verification step
Alert authority via secure channel (email, SMS, dashboard notification)
Lock execution environment (prevent further launch attempts until approval)

step_2_abort_reason_classification.action: Determine ABORT reason category to guide recovery workflow

classification.category_1_state_violation: Route to Phase 18-5 HALT scenario: unauthorized state change
classification.category_2_evidence_violation: Route to Phase 18-5 HALT scenario: evidence tampering
classification.category_3_authority_violation: Route to Phase 18-5 HOLD scenario: authority failure
classification.category_4_security_threat: Route to Phase 18-5 HALT scenario: security incident
classification.category_5_blocking_condition_reactivate: Route to Phase 18-5 HOLD scenario: blocking condition cleared
classification.category_6_timing_violation: Route to Phase 18-5 HOLD scenario: minor remedial (timing only) or defer to next window

step_3_authority_notification.action: Notify appropriate authority of ABORT and required recovery action

notification_content.failing_verification_step: Which of 6 steps failed (STEP_1 through STEP_6)

step_4_recovery_workflow.action: Execute recovery workflow based on ABORT reason category

recovery_options.option: HOLD recovery (e.g., timing, authority, blocking condition)
recovery_options.procedure: Apply remediation from Phase 18-5 HOLD procedure. Then restart from Step 1 of pre-launch verification (Step_6 of scope_2).

recovery_options.option: HALT recovery (e.g., state violation, evidence tampering, security incident)
recovery_options.procedure: Apply remediation from Phase 18-5 HALT procedure. Then restart from full Phase 18-2/18-3 fresh check suite.

step_5_re_launch_authorization.action: After recovery, obtain authority approval to attempt re-launch

approval_requirement.same_authority: If HOLD recovery (minor issue), same authority who signed Phase 18-2/18-3 can approve re-launch
approval_requirement.escalated_authority: If HALT recovery (critical issue), escalated or new authority must approve re-launch
approval_requirement.documentation: Authority must document recovery action taken and re-launch approval in audit trail

step_6_re_launch_attempt.action: After recovery and re-authorization, restart final pre-launch verification (scope_2, Step_1 through Step_6)
step_6_re_launch_attempt.success_outcome: If all 6 verification steps pass: Proceed to Phase 15-7/15-8 launch
step_6_re_launch_attempt.failure_outcome: If any step fails again: Return to Step_2 (classify reason) and iterate recovery

phase_18_6_abort_monitoring_architecture.monitoring_model: Continuous passive monitoring + active verification immediately before launch

continuous_passive_monitoring.description: Background monitoring of abort conditions (does not block execution)
monitoring_targets: State consistency (integrated_decision, receiver_validator_permission, app/tests status, production_status)
Evidence integrity (audit trail append-only integrity, lock record existence)
Security posture (threat alerts, access logs, integrity monitoring)
Blocking conditions (Phase 43 status, Phase 47-B status, dependency availability)
continuous_passive_monitoring.alerts_triggered: If any condition violates ABORT threshold, generate alert to authority but do NOT automatically ABORT (only human authority triggers ABORT)

active_verification_immediately_before_l.description: Active verification procedure executed only once, immediately before Phase 15-7/15-8 execution begins
active_verification_immediately_before_l.verification_scope: All 6 categories + 6 verification steps from scope_2

phase_18_6_completion_criteria: 6 ABORT condition categories designed with specific triggers and actions
Final pre-launch verification procedure (6 steps) designed
ABORT execution and recovery workflow (6 steps) designed
Monitoring architecture (continuous passive + active verification) defined
ABORT reason classification to Phase 18-5 recovery routing designed
No changes to app/ or tests/ directories
